latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Photo Video Maker Japanese.

- Turn your photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP up to 200MB) into Japanese-captioned slideshow videos.
- Fast cloud-based processing with 1080p MP4 output in 30–60 seconds.
- Integrated session handling, automatic token setup, and connection feedback.
- Supports prompt-based editing, batch uploads, and video customization with Japanese music and text overlays.
- Easily check credits, session state, and download finished videos.
